duration.text: The computer science and technology at East China University of Science and Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 7638 USD/per year ￥ 55000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Valid passport photo page (valid until September 1, 2026 and beyond). 2. High school graduation certificate or equivalent educational qualification certificate. For current high school graduates, a projected graduation certificate should be issued by their school. If admitted, they are required to provide a scanned copy of their graduation certificate before registration. 3. Complete transcript of all courses during high school or results from internationally recognized standardized tests (such as A-LEVEL/IB/IGCSE/AP/SAT/ACT/BC/UEC/STPM, etc.) 4. Proof of Chinese or English proficiency (The validity period of the language test result is two years. It must be within the validity period when applying) 5. Personal Statement: More than 600 words, including an introduction to personal and family background, reasons for choosing the school and major, etc.; Applicants for Chinese-taught programs should write in Chinese, while those for English-taught programs should write in English. 6. Certificate of No Criminal Record. If the home country cannot issue a certificate of no criminal record, a commitment letter for no criminal record can be signed; if currently studying in China, a proof of no misconduct during the school period can be submitted. 7. Economic guarantee certificate. 8. Copy of the physical examination form for foreigners.

requirements.text: 1. Hold a foreign ordinary passport; have a high school diploma or above, and be in good health. 2. At least 16 years old; for those who are under 18 years old as of August 31 of the application year, a guarantee letter from a Chinese or foreign adult guardian residing in China must be provided (the guardian guarantee letter template can be downloaded from the download center page). 3. In accordance with the regulations stipulated in the document "Jiaowai Hanfeng [2020] No. (For one year, if the actual residence abroad is 9 months or more, it can be calculated as one year, based on the entry and exit stamps.) 4. Language proficiency requirements: For applications requiring Chinese language instruction, one must have a HSK level 4 or above (190 points or above for science and engineering majors, 210 points or above for liberal arts and business majors, with a writing score of 60 points or above). If a proof of previous Chinese language instruction during the academic stage can be provided, the HSK certificate is not required. Applicants for English-taught programs should have a TOEFL score of 80 (inclusive) or above, an IELTS score of 6.0 (inclusive) or above, or a Duolingo score of 105 (inclusive). If applicants can provide proof of English-taught study during their previous academic stage or if they are native English speakers, they may be exempted from submitting English language proficiency test scores.
